## Checklist

- [ ] **Setup before merge is done, or N/A:** secrets, environment variables (e.g. on Render), repo settings. A deploy fails if they're missing.
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] README or decision records updated if behavior or setup changed
- [ ] New Flyway migrations are new files (no edits to migrations that have already run in production)
- [ ] **Fixes a production issue?** Add the `hotfix` label. It's used to measure change failure rate.
